items.context: @JefferyCrypt (30.500 seguidores), en inglés: Bitcoin cayó 56% desde el máximo el sábado; todos los mercados bajistas anteriores pasaron de -75%, así que o este es el más suave o no ha terminado. Post de ~1 h con 38 likes, 9 respuestas y 1441 vistas. Ángulo: Bitcoin Cycle Clock (caídas y días de recuperación por ciclo: 2011 -92,7% y 622 días; 2013 -84,5% y 1.177 días).
items.suggested_text:
Depth is only half of the pattern. Time is the other half.

In my Bitcoin Cycle Clock, the 2011 bear went -92.7% and took 622 days to reclaim the prior high; 2013 went -84.5% and took 1,177 days. Drawdowns have tended to get shallower as the asset grows, because each cycle needs far more capital to move price by the same percentage.

So -56% doesn't settle it either way. A milder bear can still be a long one, and the grind after the low has often hurt more than the drop itself.

Maybe the real question isn't how deep, but how long.
